menu.name: Bike Main 1: High-Intensity Pedaling

segments.name: High-intensity pedaling
segments.description: Push at 80-90% effort in a harder gear. Stay seated with a stable upper body

segments.name: Recovery spin
segments.description: Spin easy in a light gear, recover your breathing for the next rep

menu.description: Prep (1 min): spin in a light gear, settle breathing, check the road ahead. 8 reps of 40s hard + 20s easy. Cooldown (1 min): shift light and loosen the legs before Main 2. Approx. calories: 100-140 kcal (varies with weight/intensity)
